page: Streaming Helper for streaming responses. Import: {Hono} from 'hono', {stream, streamText, streamSSE} from 'hono/streaming'. Functions: stream(c, handler, errorHandler?), streamText(c, handler, errorHandler?), streamSSE(c, handler, errorHandler?). stream() raw streaming with Uint8Array. streamText() text/plain with Transfer-Encoding chunked. streamSSE() Server-Sent Events. Handler signature: async (stream) => {...}. Stream methods: write(Uint8Array), writeln(text), writeSSE({data, event, id}), pipe(ReadableStream), sleep(ms), onAbort(callback). Error handler: (err, stream) => {...} optional. Headers: Content-Type, Transfer-Encoding, X-Content-Type-Options. Cloudflare note: set Content-Encoding: Identity for Wrangler. Abort detection: stream.aborted flag. SSE example: loop with writeSSE. stream auto-closes after callbacks. onError hook not triggered in streaming. Questions: How to stream? Text? SSE? Error handling? Abort? Pipes?

stream() function for raw streaming responses. Signature: stream(c, handler, errorHandler?). Handler: async (stream) => {...}. Stream methods: write(Uint8Array) writes bytes, pipe(ReadableStream) pipes stream, onAbort(callback) when aborted. Example: write Uint8Array data [0x48, 0x65, 0x6c, 0x6c, 0x6f] = 'Hello'. Returns: Response object. Questions: Basic streaming? Uint8Array? Pipe? Abort?

streamText() function for text streaming responses. Headers: Content-Type: text/plain, Transfer-Encoding: chunked, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff. Handler: async (stream) => {...}. Methods: writeln(text) writes with newline, write(text) without, sleep(ms) wait. Example: writeln('Hello'), sleep(1000), write('Hono!'). Cloudflare note: set Content-Encoding: Identity for Wrangler compatibility. Questions: Text streaming? Headers? Methods? Cloudflare?

streamSSE() function for Server-Sent Events streaming. Handler: async (stream) => {...}. Method: writeSSE({data, event, id}). Loop pattern: while (!stream.aborted) {...}. Example: const message = Date.now(), writeSSE({data: message, event: 'time-update', id: String(id++)}). sleep(1000) wait between messages. SSE format: event, data, id fields. Questions: SSE format? Loop? Abort? Event names?

Error handling in streaming. Third argument: errorHandler (err, stream) => {...} optional. Default: console.error if not specified. Signature: stream(c, handler, (err, stream) => {}). Handler can: stream.writeln('error message'). Stream auto-closes after callback. Warning: onError hook NOT triggered in streaming (stream already started). Errors in callback: not caught by Hono.onError. Questions: Error handler? Optional? Auto-close? onError hook? Errors in callback?
